description: Authoritative map-matching and road-network confidence status enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3 Component C-10.

definitions.MISSING: Map package, PMTiles database, or road graph offline tile missing or unmounted.
definitions.NO_CANDIDATE: No road network segment or candidate geometry within search radius of current navigation estimate.
definitions.AMBIGUOUS: Multiple candidate roads with similar likelihood, or GNSS/heading conflict preventing unique match; matcher abstains.
definitions.CLEAR: Single unambiguously matched road candidate satisfies topological, heading, and distance gates.
definitions.FAILED: Corrupt road graph database, spatial query exception, or fatal matcher failure.
